title: East Nashville Boutique · Rooftop Deck · Sleeps 5
description:
Experience vibrant Nashville in this stylish East Nashville retreat! Sleeps 6 and is minutes to Broadway, honky-tonks, hot chicken, music venues, boutiques, and top dining. Enjoy cozy living, fast WiFi, a full kitchen, and easy access to Music City attractions. Perfect for families, groups, and festive holiday or Christmas getaways, with Nashville’s seasonal lights, events, and cheerful charm all close by.

The space
A stylish two-bedroom in a boutique East Nashville building, about seven minutes from downtown. Teal walls, warm tan leather, gallery art, and big windows with a private balcony off the living room. The kitchen is full-size with a marble island and bar seating; the living area is open-concept and bright.
Sleeps five: a queen in the primary bedroom, bunk beds in the second room, and an air mattress for a fifth guest. One bathroom.
The building's rooftop deck is the standout — skyline views, string lights, and seating for morning coffee or a drink before heading out. Roku smart TVs throughout (log in with your own accounts), fast Wi-Fi, and keyless Latch entry with a code reset after each stay.

Guest access
Guests have the entire unit to themselves — both bedrooms, the bathroom, the full kitchen, the open-concept living area, and the private balcony. You'll also have access to the building's shared rooftop deck and lounge.
Entry is keyless through the Latch system, with a unique code that's reset after each stay. Parking is first-come in the secured building garage, with shared street parking as backup.

Other things to note
-Safe Location!
-Well secured parking garage for guest only
- Towels and Linens provided
- Iron & Board/ Steamer
- Keurig Coffee machine
- Fully stocked modern kitchen
- State of the Art Appliances
- 1 Bedroom 1 Bunkroom/Nook
- 4 Beds
- Open Concept Living Area
- Rooftop with awesome views!
- Roku Smart TV's
- Smart Lock Keyless Entry
-Super fast internet

--Please do not order any kind of shipment on the property as mail boxes are locked by owners!

We are located in the heart of Downtown Nashville, where the vibrant city life adds to the charm of your stay. However, you may occasionally hear sounds from cars, planes, trains, party buses, dogs, other guests in the building, or lively passersby enjoying the area. While we can't control these elements, we hope you’ll embrace the energy of Music City as part of your experience!

Smoking Fee - $250
